verifications.claim: id: PAT_AL_RIZEIGAT; nameMain: al-Rizeigat; nameSystem: nisba; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: other

candidates.title: A History of the Arabs in the Sudan, vol. I
candidates.author: Harold Alfred MacMichael
candidates.quote: it is preferable to speak of these three tribes as having united in the south of Darfur to form the Rizaykat
candidates.supports: The group exists in south-east Darfur under the name Rizaykat (p. 290-292); says nothing on the name as a hereditary surname, so nameSystem, transmissionMode and designatedSocialUnit stay unsupported.

verifications.claim: id: PAT_AL_SHAYGIYA; nameMain: al-Shaygiya; nameSystem: nisba; transmissionMode: other; designatedSocialUnit: other

candidates.title: A History of the Arabs in the Sudan, vol. I
candidates.author: Harold Alfred MacMichael
candidates.quote: The Shaikia country consists of the rich portion of the Nile valley which lies between Gebel Dayka in southern Dongola and the upstream end of the fourth cataract
candidates.supports: The group exists in northern Sudan under the name Shaikia (p. 213-215); supports the country and spelling, not nameSystem or transmissionMode.

candidates.title: Some personal names and nicknames among the riverain people of northern Sudan
candidates.author: Ahmed Al-Shahi
candidates.quote: research among the Shaygiyya tribe of Northern Sudan
candidates.supports: Attests the spelling Shaygiyya for a tribe of northern Sudan (p. 131, note).

candidates.quote: The surnames Al-Mahdi, Al-Mirghani, Al-Hindi, Al-Sammani and Al-Majdhub indicate that the person is a descendant of the founder of a Sufi order and by extension a follower of that order
